item.title: Hotter seas, vanishing kelp, booming octopus: How Europe's marine life is changing
item.description: European waters have recorded their hottest summer, with rising temperatures affecting marine habitats and species. The Bay of Biscay experienced a significant temperature rise, with marine heatwaves extending throughout the season. Kelp forests in northern Spain have sharply declined, impacting local marine ecosystems. Additionally, octopus populations are surging in southern England, affecting traditional fishing yields. Non-native species are also expanding into the Mediterranean, altering local food chains and competitive dynamics. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: Aryan Singh

Uno de ellos era Ricardo Andrés Martínez Rodríguez, quien inicialmente fue presentado como hijo de Fredy Castillo Carrillo, alias ‘Pinocho’, líder de Autodefensas Conquistadores de la Sierra Nevada (ACSN). La realidad es que era un humilde jornalero desplazado. Hoy su padre afirma que fue liquidado con un tiro de gracia y su madre pide justicia. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
